g.text: The owner's Send from Settings, concurrent with an agent's payment from the same wallet
one lane, queue-commit order, one nonce in flight (C1, C2, C5, C11, C14; H-132, H-164, H-254; NonceAlloc)
row: payment Idle · call [wallet_usable and payer == 'owner' and fits] → Queued
row: payment Idle · call [... eff == 'always' and fits] → Queued
The store has one commit line: q1 and q2 are ordered, and the later sees the earlier (C1).
Say q1 < q2. Had the balance been under 14 USDC plus fees, the later one would be refused at
the call with the available amount, no draft (OD-8; Idle · call [... not fits] → Refused).
nonce · lane_turn [queued and can_sign and not chain_ahead] → signing
nonce · start_commit [not ledger_moved and recheck_ok] → in_flight
One in flight (C5, R-10): A waits until O is Included at latest.
nonce · included_latest [more_in_flight] → in_flight stays, else → free.
From a paired phone the owner sends only to recipients the wallet knows; a new address is confirmed on the host (OD-3).
An owner's cancel or speed-up of a payment already in the lane enters it as a command, so the lane stays the only writer
of the wallet's nonces (C2). An archive committed before q1 refuses the Send (H-047, C17).
